title: Repair a height
prompt: Return the height of the tree: the number of nodes on the longest path from root down to a leaf. An empty tree, null, has height 0. The supplied tree(value, left, right) builds a node.
hints: In the sample tree, the longest path does not go down the left edge. Which way does it turn?
The height of a node is one more than the height of its taller subtree.
Return 1 + Math.max(height(root.left), height(root.right)), with 0 for null.
checkLabels: The longest path in the sample is 8, 3, 6, 4.
A path down the right side counts.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts every node instead of the longest path.

feedback: Trust the two recursive calls: each returns the height of one subtree. What do you do with two heights to get the height of the whole tree?
